purpose: Teach: 澆/椶/僂/彡/シーク/同省/未確認/西方

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、農業向け澆水、つまり澆灌設備を販売しろ
lines.en: I want us to start selling irrigation equipment for agricultural use.
lines.style: Clipped authority. Direct eye contact. Each word lands like a directive. No softening, no elaboration. The tone of someone accustomed to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。観葉植物の椶、つまり椶櫚商品を強化します
lines.en: Understood. I'll strengthen our houseplant—palm product line.
lines.style: Brisk acknowledgment. Slight catch as he rephrases mid-sentence, recovering smoothly. Businesslike pace, note-taking cadence. Showing he's already thinking of next steps.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員が僂佝、つまり僂姿勢にならない様、人間工学椅子を導入しろ
lines.en: And roll out ergonomic chairs company-wide. I won't have staff developing bad posture.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact concern threaded through authority. Not a request—a requirement dressed as reason. Pauses fractionally before 'ergonomic' to let the practicality land.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。書道家にデザインの彡、つまり彡偏ロゴを依頼します
lines.en: Got it. I'll commission a calligrapher to redesign our logo.
lines.style: Quick nod. Efficient, almost clipped. No hesitation—he's already sorting through who to contact. The tone of someone building a mental checklist in real time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、シーク教徒、つまりシーク派のお客様向けハラル対応も検討しろ
lines.en: Also look into Halal-compliant options for our Sikh and Muslim customers.
lines.style: Steady, inclusive direction. Not tentative—'look into' is instruction, not suggestion. The tone of someone thinking a step ahead about market respect and care.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。同省、つまり経産省との折衝を進めます
lines.en: Understood. I'll start coordinating with the Ministry of Economy.
lines.style: Affirmative clip. Steady, capable tone. Slight uptick of confidence as he names the ministry—showing he already grasps the scope. Professional momentum building.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新製品の未確認情報の漏洩に注意しろ
lines.en: And be careful—keep any unconfirmed product information internal.
lines.style: Sharp, protective edge. Lower tone on 'careful,' like a warning from someone who's seen damage before. Not alarmist, but deliberate. The weight of experience behind a simple instruction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。西方諸国、つまり西方の市場開拓を進めます
lines.en: Noted. I'll move forward with expanding into Western markets.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Crisp, resolved tone. Slight settling into the chair—he's absorbing everything, ready to execute. The rhythm of someone at the end of a meeting who's about to stand and get to work.
